note: Ellis implements a self-consistent SANDBOX. These are the items Trip.com must provide to finalize the production integration. Do not treat sandbox shapes as production-final.

must_provide.authentication_method: OAuth2 client-credentials | mutual-TLS | signed-JWT (Trip.com to specify)
must_provide.request_signing_rules: canonicalization + header names + algorithm (Ellis sandbox uses HMAC-SHA256 over ts.nonce.body)
must_provide.api_schemas: case create, document reference, case-status GET
must_provide.webhook_schemas: case.status, payment.status, appointment.status, submission.status field definitions + retry/backoff policy
must_provide.webhook_signing: how Trip.com signs inbound webhooks to Ellis and how Ellis signs outbound
must_provide.country_launch_priorities: ordered country list for adapter rollout
must_provide.data_residency: regions where applicant data must reside
must_provide.branding: logo/theme/localized copy for the applicant handoff
